title: Bag
cracked: The screen has a crack across it.

wallet.name: Wallet
wallet.desc: Your cash: {cash}. Cash is easy to spend and easy to lose. Use it to see everything you own and owe.

journal.name: Money Journal
journal.desc: Professor Arth's gift. {seen} money ideas written in so far.

documents.name: ID card and address proof
documents.desc: Your KYC documents. Show them only to the bank, never in reply to a message or call.

debit_card.name: Debit card
debit_card.desc: Linked to your savings account ({balance}). The PIN lives in your head, never on the card, never on the phone.

phone.name: Old phone
phone.desc: Calls and messages. No UPI yet: you need a bank account for that.

phone_upi.name: Phone with UPI
phone_upi.desc: Pays by scanning a QR code. Recent UPI payments: {recent}. Remember: a PIN is only ever for paying.

badge_case.name: Badge case
badge_case.desc: {n} of 6 badges earned from Paisapur's Masters.

goal_trip.name: Trip photos
goal_trip.desc: Your school trip, paid for in month {month} ({price}). Experiences don't resell, but nobody can take the memories back.

goal_cycle.name: Geared cycle
goal_cycle.desc: Bought in month {month} for {price}. Worth about {now} now: things lose value as they age.

goal_fees.name: Coaching admission letter
goal_fees.desc: Fees of {price} paid in month {month}. Learning is an investment in what you can earn.

goal_phone.name: New phone
goal_phone.desc: Bought in month {month} for {price}. It would sell for about {now} now. That's depreciation.

goal_stall.name: Stall key
goal_stall.desc: Your market stall: {price} in month {month}, still worth about {now}, and earning ₹600 every month. An asset that pays you.

goal_laptop.name: Laptop
goal_laptop.desc: Bought in month {month} for {price}. Worth about {now} now, but what you learn on it keeps its value.

goal_bike.name: Bike
goal_bike.desc: Bought in month {month} for {price}. Worth about {now} now, and it still needs fuel and servicing.

thing_sneakers.name: Branded sneakers
thing_sneakers.desc: "50% off!" Bought for {price} in month {month}. Would sell for about {now} now.

thing_headphones.name: Wireless headphones
thing_headphones.desc: Bought for {price} in month {month}. Worth about {now} now.

thing_poster.name: Cricket poster
thing_poster.desc: Bought for {price} in month {month}. Priceless to you, about {now} to anyone else.

receipt.name: Receipt: {item}
receipt.desc: Month {month}: {item}, {price}, including {gst} of GST ({rate}%). Tax is part of almost every price you pay.

fd.name: Fixed deposit receipt
fd.desc: {amount} locked until month {month}. Worth {now} today, growing every month.

bond.name: Town bond certificate
bond.desc: You lent the town {amount} for the bridge. Repaid with interest in month {month}. Worth {now} today.

loan.name: Loan agreement: {kind}
loan.desc: You still owe {balance}. EMI {emi} for {months} more months at {rate}% a month. Missed payments so far: {missed}.

card_statement.name: Credit card statement
card_statement.desc: Balance {balance} at {rate}% a month. Paying only the minimum keeps this debt alive for a long time.

statement.name: Investment statement
statement.desc: {count} holdings across {kinds} kinds of investment. Worth {value} today; you put in {invested}.

policy.name: Insurance policy
policy.desc: ₹100 a month protects your things from fire and disaster. You hope you never need it.
